bind.description: Listen address. Keep it on loopback.

default_target.description: Lease target when an agent names none.

data_dir.description: Decision log folder (no fact text is stored).

questions.description: Routing questions sent with each fact; generated from your machines.

type.description: `jev` (OpenRouter typed decisions), `anthropic` (Claude via the Messages API) or `openai` (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

base_url.description: API base URL. Defaults per type; set it for OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio or a proxy.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable holding the API key. Default: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

api_key_file.description: File holding the API key. Default: `openrouter.key`, `anthropic.key` or `openai.key` beside this config.

timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the provider.

max_tokens.description: Output token cap for chat providers (includes any thinking).

effort.description: Anthropic `output_config.effort`. Unset uses the model default; `low` suits this task on models that support effort.

json_mode.description: OpenAI-compatible only: send `response_format: {"type": "json_object"}`. Enable for servers that support it.
